walkthrough.query: the fifth drinks from the right in the first row from the top
walkthrough.normalised: from top {first} row from right {fifth} drink
walkthrough.route_reason: template read and stated in the query
walkthrough.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    patches = image_patch.find("drink")
    lines = group_lines(patches, "top")
    if len(lines) < 1:
        return None
    seq = order_from(lines[0], "right")
    return seq[4] if len(seq) >= 5 else None

walkthrough.query: black van in front of cab
walkthrough.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    vans = image_patch.find("black van")
    cabs = image_patch.find("cab")
    if not vans or not cabs: return image_patch
    van_depth = vans[0].compute_depth()
    in_front = [c for c in cabs if c.compute_depth() < van_depth]
    return in_front[0] if in_front else vans[0]
walkthrough.program_source: generated by DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite with prompt C5
walkthrough.property_test:
def execute_test(image_patch):
    assert image_patch.exists("van")
    assert image_patch.verify_property("van", "black")
    assert image_patch.best_text_match(["van in front of cab", "cab in front of van"]) == "van in front of cab"
